propositions: External integration tests run live against only one provider (Anthropic) despite rebar supporting multiple credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regression blind spots in CI

Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows with one arm per credentialed provider, using REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE overlays to set [llm.model_classes] per arm rather than ambient defaults or bespoke wiring

Bedrock arm must authenticate via OIDC role assumption (aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials) to a dedicated scoped role, not via API key secret or EC2 instance role, and must explicitly set both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION as job environment variables
Missing credentials for a provider must cause its matrix arm to skip loudly and visibly rather than reading as green, preventing silent failures from indistinguishable results

Config overlay path REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must deep-merge [llm.model_classes] only without affecting other config, and ambient fallback cfg.model must resolve to the declared provider not DEFAULT_MODEL
Live canary test execution counts must be recorded per arm to distinguish genuine execution from vacuous all-skip results
